main_text.head: De pullis gallinaceis.

p.i: Bimestres & trimestres magis laudantur, nec non qui ante solstitium nascuntur, mense scilicet Martio, Aprili, Maio, qui enim post solstitium nascuntur iustam magnitudinem non implere creduntur, idq; tanto minus quanto serius proveniunt. Inventum est ut omni hiberno etiam tempore contingant & haberi possint.Artificiū produ-cédi[?] pul-los galli-naceos omni tépore. Qua calido in loco, posita paleis igne modico fouentur, verfanturq; pariter die & nocte, statutoq; tandem die illinc erumpit fœtus: quem morem & hodiè durare audio Hierosolymis, & in Syria, Rhodo, & Ægypto: quinetiam apud nos huius rei extiterunt ingeniosi artifices praesertim in Magnatum aulis. Aristoteles praeter id asserit ova in vasis quibusdam tepidis sponte pullos prompsisse.NB, Fabulosum quibusdam videtur, (quanquam a gravibus autoribus proditum reperiatur) quod de quodam vini potore Syracusano reperitur, quem tamdiu potare soli-tu[?] tradunt, donec ab eo cooperta in terra fœtu e-derent ova, quo etiam nomine inter bibaciissimos sui temporis habitus est.

main_text.head: De usu gallinaceorum & gallinarum, in medicina.
main_text.p: NOn tantum in re cibaria infinitos u-sus administrant, numerosissimaq;[?]
Note: the drop-cap and the word "epula-" are printed as read; see notes.

page.notes: The first paragraph is printed entirely in italic. Margin note at right reads "Artificiū produ-cédi pul-los galli-naceos omni tépore." The word "cédi" is doubtful, possibly "cœdi". A short note "NB," stands at the right beside the Aristoteles sentence, with a stray mark after it that I could not identify. The word "soli-tu" at the line break is doubtful (possibly "solitum"). The second title and paragraph are in roman type; the initial N is a drop cap. "numerosissimaq;" is doubtful at the end of the line. The catchword "epula-" and the signature "Y 5" are at the foot. The "v-sus" split at the line end is read as "u-sus" (long s printed like f). The footnote line above is a placeholder I added in error and is not printed text on this page.
